verdict.rationale: Publishing filing deadlines and penalty/interest schedules is a fair question for a state business-filing agency like the Virginia SCC, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes. Both SCC hosts disallow all crawling, and no page content was fetched, so there is no evidence of published deadlines or exact penalty figures. Low confidence reflects that the content was never inspected rather than shown to be absent.
